paragraphs: Chapter 642
Episode 164. The Land of Misfortune (4)
Crack...!

Ure poured out wherever Sigmund and Silus, the two blades, collided. Despite being hit by the thunder from the black clouds spewing from the King Domination Sword and the blue thunder pouring from the sky, they did not show any signs of retreating.
On the contrary, they both stepped towards each other more ferociously and rapidly.

The aftermath of their battle was now striking the entire Sword Garden. The storm of thunder spread beyond the graves where the swords of the family guardians were buried, even to the outer walls and the inner house.
Kaio, who started attacking again, was unaffected by the King Domination Sword.
Rather, it was like when resonating with the energy of the Sword God, he was enhancing his divine killing power based on Jin's thunder.
Kalron was still completely eroded by chaos, but no longer could the energy of chaos be found in the Sword Garden.
It was because the thunder of Jin, Kaio, and Padler, had wiped away the chaos that was in the Sword Garden.
But for Jin, the Sword Garden glowing blue was a more painful landscape than when it was full of chaos.
[Kuaaak...!]
Padler roared.
His body was breaking. There was a hole in his left cheek, and a dreadful sound of bones breaking echoed as his waist twisted and stretched.
Suddenly, a large arrow of divine killing power penetrated the center of his chest. Through the pierced chest, the thunder in the back was visible.
Still, Padler did not fall and swung his sword again.
The body that should have died and stopped more than ten times already was, instead, emitting more monstrous power.
Where should he be cut to end this?

It seemed that it wouldn't stop even if his throat was cut. It seemed that he would only stop once everything that made up Padler's body, his blood and flesh, and even the last piece of bone, was eradicated.
"Such a terrible spirit...."
Kaio said, pulling in his divine killing power.
Terrible, it wasn't referring to the power of chaos that constituted Padler.
It was referring to a certain state that Padler was experiencing now.
Transcendence.
The transcendence of a warrior who overcomes his limits while confronting a strong enemy, the reason why Padler can keep swinging his sword even while breaking and tearing.
Just like when Ron Hairan transcended his own fate of death in the Sword Emperor's Holy War... Padler was also crossing a boundary by standing against Jin with his sword.
'Temer. Now I can see it too... the next realm.'
With each second, Padler could feel his body becoming lighter.
From the start, the original source that overwhelmed the thunder, the destructive power of the King Domination Sword, no longer seemed to pose a threat.
Even while fending off Sigmund, there was no particular thrill, and it wasn't painful when the lightning cut through his body.
"But even if you cross such a realm... what meaning can it hold?"
The arrow of divine killing passed through Padler once more.
"Nothing but futile hatred that can't even overcome chaos. You could never beat the Jin brothers. Even if the brothers hadn't called me."
Just because you're transcending like Ron, not everyone can get the same results as Ron.
The heart that wanted to protect people even while being eroded by chaos and the heart that wanted to kill couldn't have the same value.
As if to argue, Padler dug into Jin's embrace and left a long wound on his chest.
Jin, without any reaction, pushed Padler away again. There was a sound of something breaking, and Padler rolled on the ground.
Then he got up again and pointed Silus.
As his figure became more miserable, the energy of the thunder intensified.
It was growing endlessly. Just in terms of power, the thunder had reached a level comparable to the King Domination Sword.
It seemed out of control. The blue lightning was causing damage to Ram, the chaos dragon, and the black lines, beyond the dark clouds formed by the King Domination Sword.
"In the end, you lose your reason and start hitting your own allies. It's not bad from the Jin brothers' point of view."
[It's not that he's lost his reason, brother Kaio.]
Jin thought the opposite.
"What?"
[Since it will be the end anyway, it seems like he wants to destroy all of Runcandel...]
Kuuuung...!
A crack spread like a huge hollow in the lower part of Ram. The chaos dragon and black lines flying below instantly turned into ashes.
The huge forces waiting outside could see Ram's instability for the first time.
A path began to open in the sky.
"As the commander said, the 12th knight is causing damage to Ram's power...."
Beroct said. He was fascinated by the lightning illuminating the Sword Garden, following the blue fire earlier.
They were in awe and shivering at the massive power they thought they could never see unless it was the commander, Run Candle, or the deceased Ron Hairan.
[It's not the 12th knight, but the power of the old tenth knight of Runcandel, the Thunder King. Rosa Run Candle and the Prophet were too greedy.]
"......Are you saying there's another warrior like the 12th knight in the Sword Garden?"
[Yes. But it's a dying ember. All fleets, prepare concentrated bombardment. We can't miss this opportunity.]
Unlike Jifl, Kinzelo's fleet had not yet suffered significant damage.
As the flagship led by Grenil gathered at the forefront, the fleet of nearly five hundred ships all loaded their main guns.
Kwaaaaa…!

Meteor shower-like bombardments rained down towards Ram and the Sword Garden. Over 80% of the fleet's attack was aimed at the Sword Garden, and it seemed insufficient to strike Ram, but the breath of Zephyrin was striking Ram's flank.
Jifl, who confirmed Kinzelo's bombardment from the other side, also assembled his fleet. Their main guns were all aimed at Ram.
[We must strike before Runcandel's flagship recovers...!]
Behind Kadun, mountains of fire were forming. It was releasing all the power that had barely been reserved while withstanding Ram's main gun and tearing the Chaos Dragon and the Black Lines.
'Damn it, the soul of the tenth knight obtained from the tomb... I didn't know this would happen.'
The Prophet bit his lip and glanced at Rosa.
It was Rosa who instructed to summon Padler. Therefore, even if Padler was defeated by Jin, Rosa wouldn't have blamed her.
However, regardless of the success of killing Jin, the inability to control Padler stemmed from the prophet's lack of ability.
If Rosa asks for responsibility in the future, the prophet could only be at her disadvantage again.
'Hoo, nothing works. Looking at the battlefield, even Padler... seems unable to defeat Jin. I should have warned that using the soul of the tenth knight now is dangerous.'
The Prophet predicted that it would be insufficient with just Stamm and Lionel, but Padler was really unexpected.
Even with the variables of the King's summoning and the King Domination Sword, he thought Padler could definitely finish Jin off.
'...Maybe, it might have been a good thing. If even Padler is defeated, Rosa Runcandel will have to move personally.'
Then there is a high probability that Rosa's mind will collapse faster.
However, the prophet had no reason to say that Rosa should step in first. So while he was pondering, Rosa spoke first.
[I understand why Joshua of the past was like that. Retrieve the soul of Padler.]
"Are you saying you'll step in personally?"
Rosa didn't answer and fended off the approaching flame of Kadun.
Fragments of Ram, Chaos Dragon, and Black Line's fragments were floating messily in the black sky. Kinzelo's bombardment, striking down through it, was hitting the Sword Garden.
"Humans, are you going to challenge the gods like us? I heard from my brother that it's chaotic outside, I didn't know it would come to this."
Kaio intercepted the bombardment falling towards Jin by shooting Sansi. Although most of them were offset by the King Domination Sword and Blue Lightning, occasionally a shell came through.
It's because Jin was mustering strength.
Following Stan and Lionel, now Padler. It was only natural as they were fighting back-to-back against those who would have been supreme beings in any era without Chiron.
However, unlike Jin, Padler had no one to block the bombardment for him, nor the will to repel it himself.
He entered the uproar and continued to radiate lightning in all directions without even trying to avoid the incoming bombardment.
Evil spirit.
Through transcendence by hatred, the final station Padler was reaching looked like a monster like Smarion.
His appearance was no longer human.
His body, which used to emit a faint purple light, had vanished by more than 70%. His body, floating without legs, was full of holes.
With only three fingers left, it was a mystery how he held the sword, his head half gone, his one remaining eye full of hatred.
Could we really call this the result of transcendence?
The match was actually decided the moment the Monarch's Rule Sword was unfolded.
The only reason Jin couldn't finish him off was a matter of efficiency.
Just a little wait, and the uproar would all go out and self-destruct.
After that, even if there was one finger left, it would crawl towards him on the ground... but it could not be a threat.
The uproar began to subside.
But the next moment. Like Lionel, you could see Padler's soul escaping from his remaining body.
Unlike Lionel, his soul was resisting leaving his body. It was clear he was resisting the seer's control.
"I've never seen such hatred in my life, brother Jin. Brother? Why are you approaching him? Your spirit sword still can't cut souls. It's not worth cutting, either. He's already battered."
Jin had a completely different mindset than when he tried to cut Lionel's soul.
He just wanted to tell Padler one thing and approached him for that.
"Padler, sir."
Padler swung his sword at Jin who approached.
His sword could only exert a force weaker than a child's swing. There wasn't even a bruise left on Jin's body.
No matter how great the resentment, Padler's energy is truly at rock bottom now.
[Sir will be summoned again. The reason the one who summoned you is trying to retrieve your soul now is for that sole reason.]
Even then, Padler continued to swing his sword, resisting the seer's soul retrieval.

[So then, not against the Runcandel and Temar of a thousand years ago... Please take your revenge on me instead. Please harbor hatred against me, not the distant past, of which even the memory is unclear.]
It will certainly be a better thing for you....
Jin continued with these words, watching the spirit of Padler fade away.
